description: This file implements the AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) socket logic for Bluetooth audio streaming, including serialization and deserialization of signals, handling packet fragmentation, and processing signal data.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Represents an AVDTP signal with methods for serialization and deserialization, managing signal state, and handling packet fragmentation.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the signal into a byte stream, handling fragmentation if necessary.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a signal, reconstructing fragmented signals and extracting signal data.
